column3: CREATE KEYSPACE ks WITH replication = {'class': 'SimpleStrategy', 'replication_factor': 3} AND durable_writes = true;
CREATE TABLE ks.tbl (id int, ck text, s int STATIC, data map<text, int>, tags set<text>, PRIMARY KEY ((id), ck)) WITH CLUSTERING ORDER BY (ck ASC);
SELECT a, b, writetime(c) FROM ks.tbl WHERE id = 1 AND ck IN ('x', 'y') ORDER BY ck DESC LIMIT 10 ALLOW FILTERING;
INSERT INTO ks.tbl (id, ck, data) VALUES (1, 'a', {'k': 2}) USING TTL 60 AND TIMESTAMP 999;
UPDATE ks.tbl USING TIMESTAMP 12345 SET data = data + {'k': 1}, s = 7 WHERE id = 1 AND ck = 'a' IF s = 6;
DELETE data['k'] FROM ks.tbl WHERE id = 1 AND ck = 'a' IF EXISTS;
SELECT * FROM ks.tbl WHERE ck IN ?;
UPDATE ks.tbl SET v = 1 WHERE id = 1 IF v = ?;
SELECT id, count(*) FROM ks.tbl GROUP BY id;
SELECT * FROM ks.tbl PER PARTITION LIMIT 2 LIMIT 10;
SELECT JSON id, v FROM ks.tbl;
SELECT CAST(v AS text) FROM ks.tbl;
SELECT * FROM ks.tbl WHERE tags CONTAINS 'x' ALLOW FILTERING;
SELECT * FROM ks.tbl WHERE data CONTAINS KEY 'k' ALLOW FILTERING;
